description: NaCdVO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.41 Å) and four longer (2.44 Å) Na-O bond lengths. V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-51°. All V-O bond lengths are 1.75 Å. Cd is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.14 Å) and two longer (2.39 Å) Cd-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one V, and one Cd atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂VCd tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one V, and one Cd atom.
